from donations import load_donations, ROWS
from tagged import labelled_poundss


def test_fewer_labels():
    data = list(load_donations())
    pairs = labelled_poundss(data, ["a", "b"])
    assert len(pairs) == len(ROWS) and pairs[-1] == ("unlabelled", ROWS[-1][1])


def test_equal_lengths():
    data = list(load_donations())
    labels = ["l%d" % i for i in range(len(data))]
    assert labelled_poundss(data, labels)[-1] == (labels[-1], ROWS[-1][1])
